title: Ing Ain a Mekapagbayu king Tadhana
intro: keng minunang panaun ning pangatau, ing kaladwa mag-alok yang regalu a maki dalit a intensyun. Pero, ing inggit makalukluk ya keng anino ning pamananggap. abalu me ing istorya na niting tau na ing kayang kabanalan ampo makalunus a wakas me-mortalize ya keng dibinung kapahayagan.
clues: Metung ku kareng mumunang henerasyun ning tau.
Minie kung ain king Ginu ku, at tinggap na iti king mitmung kalam.
Ing ain ning kapatad ku e ya tinggap, at ing inggit pepadalumdum ne ing pusu na.
Sinabi ku keya, Nung iyatyat mu ing gamat mu kanaku ban paten mu ku, e ku na iyunat ing gamat ku ban paten da ka; tutu kung tatakut keng Allah, Ginu da reng yatu.'
Meging biktima na ku ning mumunang dapat ning pamakamate tau keti king yatu.
Ing daya ku kinulisak ya, at aku ing mumunang martir ning alang kasalanan.

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
